description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useRecipes' that provides CRUD operations and state management (loading, error, data) for recipes. It interacts with an API client to fetch and modify recipe data, encapsulating logic for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting recipes with fallback endpoints.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches the list of recipes, with support for fallback endpoint.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches details of a single recipe by ID, with fallback endpoint.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new recipe with the provided payload.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing recipe identified by ID with the given payload.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a recipe by its ID.
